notes.read: answers from what is already there. The flags that answer from a map (--ask, --more, --callers, --callees, --impact, --sections) append one line to <out>/.wawe-ask.log unless WAWE_ASK_LOG=0; nothing else is written, and nothing outside <out> is.
notes.writes-map-dir: writes the map files and the parse cache under --out.
notes.writes-repo: writes into the repository being mapped: a manifest, an agent file, the READMEs a directory has none of.
notes.writes-config: writes where a tool other than this one reads: .git/hooks, ~/.claude/settings.json, ~/.codex/config.toml, a Cursor rule, a Gemini setting.
notes.network: goes off this machine: a tracker fetch, a runs API.
